title: Demo Builder Shipped Block Examples Schema
description: The examples Demo Builder ships for one source's blocks (template.json for the B2B template, one file per block library id). Each key is a block id; its value is the example page body and a one-line description. Read by src/features/eds/services/blockLibrary/shippedBlockExamples.ts; checked on every test run by tests/features/eds/services/blockLibrary/shippedExampleStructure.test.ts.

description.description: One line: what the block is for and how to fill it in. Written as a library-metadata table after each example.

structureOnly.description: Set only for a block that cannot show outside a real storefront; says why (for example, it needs a live store). The render check then reports the example STRUCTURE ONLY with this reason instead of rendering it to PASS or FAIL. Never written to the storefront.
